aggregation.agreement: guard plan == logged plan on the same snapshot, over rows with both a guard plan and a logged decision
aggregation.anchor_kept: guard plan == anchor, over rows with a guard plan (exact + fallback)
aggregation.category: no_snapshot: row has no observation (admission_drop / not_sent); fallback: guard falls back to the anchor on the reconstructed poll ages (exact); exact: guard decision fully determined by logged fields; non_reconstructible: the decision needs the queue estimate of a busy worker whose service_ms was not logged
aggregation.logged_status: the logged policy outcome of that row (its own plan); descriptive join only, never a guard outcome
aggregation.replay_fidelity: greedy_comm / dag_reopt / dag_reopt_no_network re-decided on their own snapshot vs their logged decision (plan label and predicted_ms within 1e-06 ms, fallback reason)
aggregation.totals: sums of per-cell counts; by_policy/by_trace/by_block are the same sums over subsets
aggregation.unit: one ledger row (scheduled arrival) of one cell; requests inside a cell are not independent replicates

claims: none: no latency, deadline hit, goodput, completion or success rate of dag_deadline_guard is estimated; per-snapshot decisions are not a counterfactual trace

integration.boundary: experiments/unstable-network/generator.py imports its own policies.build and QualityGate; it does NOT accept dag_deadline_guard. A next runner must import deadline_policies.build (and ExecutionOnly) instead; that runner/generator copy is not part of this change.
integration.deadline_rule: spec.deadline_ms must equal the trace deadline_s x 1000 of the same run
integration.decide: policy.decide(observation, now) with the generator Observation (base Observation class) and its monotonic clock
integration.log_for_next_run: per decision: observation service_ms per worker and evidence ages of compute/link estimates (not logged by the base generator)
